algorithm: Verify downloaded file bytes against download-receipt SHA-256/size and Git blob SHA-1 or LFS SHA-256.
Verify all 108 task files against the code-release task-hash manifest and compare both release JSON files with the pinned code checkout.
Verify all 16 historical task files against their source-receipt SHA-256/size.
Parse source as Python AST without importing it. Resolve literal class id, including module TASK_ID constants, and match TASK_CLASS export.
Hash complete source files and component line spans; compare AST dumps of instructions/methods/functions with include_attributes=False.
Describe source semantics and qualification limits using inspected task/helper code and official implementation notes.
reproducibility.source_lines_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenation of complete original source lines from start_line through end_line inclusive, preserving original line terminators.
reproducibility.ast_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 ast.dump(node, annotate_fields=True, include_attributes=False), using the reported Python version.
reproducibility.inventory_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON of receipt file objects {path,sha256,bytes}, sorted by path, using sort_keys=True and separators=(comma,colon).

work_boundaries.previous_unauthenticated_access_check: Retained unchanged in the same directory. Authenticated possession supersedes the earlier materialization blocker only; it does not change anonymous access or runtime qualification.
